extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as f9f768fff3119031a7444b7d53c5a412cdb028388e1db09c1d43f67990e33fb7 before extraction.
Page 1 states Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified; page 2 curves explicitly retain their plotted temperature and bias conditions.
Curve points are manual digitizations from the page 2 raster plots, rounded to honest plot-reading precision; they are not interpolated datasheet tables.

The page 1 hFE table provides only three collector-current rows: 1 mA minimum 80, 10 mA minimum 100 and maximum 300, and 50 mA minimum 50. The page 2 typical hFE curve supplies additional digitized typical points.

Page 1 also publishes collector-base breakdown minimum 180 V at IC = 100 uA and IE = 0, emitter-base breakdown minimum 6 V at IE = 10 uA and IC = 0, collector cutoff current maximum 50 nA at VCB = 120 V and IE = 0, and emitter cutoff current maximum 50 nA at VEB = 4 V and IC = 0.
Page 1 maximum ratings include IC = 0.6 A, PC = 0.3 W, RthetaJA = 416 degC/W, Tj = 150 degC, and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC; those fields are not present in this extraction schema.
The page 1 hFE classification gives rank L = 100 to 200 and rank H = 200 to 300; rank metadata is not represented in this extraction schema.

No Early-voltage scalar is reported because the datasheet does not tabulate an Early voltage and the static characteristic plot is not used for an extrapolated VAF value. No exact tabulated Cibo value is published; Cibo is represented by its digitized typical curve and one digitized point.
extraction.omission_reason: Not represented by the supplied schema: VAF/Early voltage, VCBO and VEBO as scalar spec fields, ICBO and IEBO, IC and power/thermal absolute ratings, hFE rank-bin metadata, and a tabulated VBE(on) scalar. Cibo has no exact table row and is therefore represented only by digitized typical curve evidence.
